rubric.question: Which specific banking support intent best matches the customer message? Choose the most specific issue expressed.

criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: top up by bank transfer charge
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: balance not updated after cheque or cash deposit
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: top up by cash or cheque
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: wrong exchange rate for cash withdrawal
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: balance not updated after bank transfer

measurement: UTF-8 JSON bytes, not billed tokens. Full-review metric includes every full review row, even already-previewed rows. Excludes MCP framing, host duplication and agent reasoning.

baselines.definition: Multinomial Naive Bayes; Laplace alpha=1; lowercase Unicode word tokens of length >=2; raw counts, no tuning. Training examples are never sent to Jev.

pricing_note: Jev 1.13.0: $0.042/M input tokens, free output. Estimate excludes agent review and reasoning. When cost_accounting_complete is false, known successful usage is only a lower bound.

dataset.name: banking77
dataset.selection: 10 per class, sorted labels, then shuffle
dataset.notes: Follow-up on previously unqueried IDs and exact contents from the same public test corpus. Not a distribution-shift test or evidence of absence from pretraining. Baseline uses previous source training data with new evaluation duplicates removed.
